nodes.description: IERC20 constant TORN token address used for transfers and approvals
Vesting constant contract holding governance treasury vesting schedule
ISablier constant stream contract used to create the token stream
Gnosis Safe address receiving transferred tokens and stream
Constant percentage (5) of treasury to fund the multisig
Constant seconds per month (30 days)
Constant number of months per year (12)
Constant seconds per year, used for stream duration and rounding
Constant 100 used as percentage denominator
Public function that releases vested funds, transfers 5% and creates a Sablier stream
Block timestamp used to compute elapsed months and stream start/stop times
External ERC20 transfer of 5% of released funds to the community multisig
External ERC20 approval of the Sablier contract for the adjusted deposit
External call creating a Sablier stream to the multisig over one year
Local variable holding GOV_VESTING.released() amount
Local variable for (block.timestamp - startTimestamp) / SECOND_PER_MONTH
Local variable for releasedFunds divided by elapsedMonths
Local variable for 5% of the next twelve months of vesting
Local variable for the deposit rounded down to a multiple of the stream period
Arithmetic division of releasedFunds by elapsedMonths which may be zero

edges.reason: executeProposal invokes TORN.transfer
executeProposal invokes TORN.approve
executeProposal invokes SABLIER.createStream
executeProposal calls GOV_VESTING.vestedAmount, release and released
TORN token instance is used to perform the transfer
SABLIER address is the spender being approved
SABLIER contract receives the createStream call
COMMUNITY_MULTISIG is the transfer recipient
COMMUNITY_MULTISIG is the stream recipient
PERCENT_OF_TREASURY scales the transferred amount
HUNDRED is the percentage denominator for the transfer
releasedFunds is read from GOV_VESTING.released()
releasedFunds * 5% is the amount transferred
SECOND_PER_MONTH converts elapsed seconds into months
block.timestamp determines elapsedMonths and thus the payout size
releasedFunds is the numerator of the per-month division
elapsedMonths is the denominator and can be zero causing division by zero
the division result is assigned to vestingPerMonth
MONTH_PER_YEAR scales the twelve month projection
vestingPerMonth is multiplied into sablierDeposit
PERCENT_OF_TREASURY scales the sablier deposit
HUNDRED is the denominator of the sablier deposit calculation
sablierDeposit is rounded down into sablierAdjustedDeposit
SECOND_PER_YEAR is the modulus used to adjust the deposit
sablierAdjustedDeposit is the approved amount
sablierAdjustedDeposit is the stream deposit amount
block.timestamp sets the stream start and stop times
external TORN.transfer call could re-enter executeProposal before state settles
external SABLIER.createStream call could re-enter executeProposal

normalization_plan.reason: local variable is derived from GOV_VESTING and consumed directly as the transfer amount
local variable is only used as the denominator of the vesting per month division
local variable is the direct result of the division operation
local variable is an intermediate amount that ultimately becomes the stream deposit
local variable is passed directly as the deposit of the Sablier stream
